name: Rhode Island
sources: 2026 rate schedule (one schedule for all filing statuses), standard deduction $11,200 / $22,400 / $16,800, exemption $5,250, phase-out of both over modified federal AGI $261,000-$290,800 in $7,450 steps: RI Division of Taxation Advisory ADV 2025-22 (tax.ri.gov/sites/g/files/xkgbur541/files/2025-11/ADV_2025_22_Inflation_Adjustments.pdf)

Phase-out worksheet mechanics (20% per step) and no itemized deductions: 2025 RI-1040 Tax Rate and Worksheets (tax.ri.gov/sites/g/files/xkgbur541/files/2026-01/2025%20Tax%20Rate%20and%20Worksheets.pdf)
Millionaires' surtax (1% from 2027) does not apply to 2026: EY Tax News 2026-1486
notes: Rhode Island phases out the standard deduction and exemptions in 20% steps between $261,000 and $290,800; this estimate phases them out smoothly.
